visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with blonde-dyed hair, wearing black thick-rimmed glasses and a black baseball cap, is framed in a medium close-up. He holds a small wooden brush in his right hand and a small white dish in his left, carefully applying a vertical red stripe of face paint to his right cheek. (2) Through a sequence of jump cuts, he adds a white stripe next to the red one. The background is an indoor setting featuring a blue blueprint-style wall poster and a red inflatable object with a white logo. His facial expression remains focused as he works on the face paint. (3) The man then applies blue paint to his left palm in a circular pattern. He raises his hand toward the camera, then swipes it quickly across his face. As he does so, identical tricolor patterns (red, white, and blue) appear on his left cheek and chin through editing or a magic trick reveal. (4) The final phase shows the completed face paint resembling the French flag. The man looks directly into the lens with a slight, confident smile. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio or well-lit indoor environment, with a fast-paced zoom-in effect during the transition.
